fault_detail.summary: EF.SOD lists DG3 per conformant EAC issuance; EF.DG3 unreadable without EAC on BAC-only path — tests whether reader distinguishes unverifiable SOD entry from hash failure
fault_detail.injection_site: EF.SOD lists DG3; EF.DG3 requires EAC for READ BINARY — BAC-only path

conformance_basis.clause: Part 10 §4.6.2 (EF.SOD DG hash list); §4.7.3 (DG3); TR-03110 EAC access precondition
conformance_basis.summary: Listing DG3 in EF.SOD while EF.DG3 requires EAC for read matches conformant EAC passport construction; a BAC-only terminal legitimately cannot read EF.DG3 — not a writer defect
